final: WITH p AS (SELECT l.ID, pt.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS apt, AVG(CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS ar FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = l.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory x WHERE x.ID = l.ID AND x."U-PRO" = '-') GROUP BY l.ID, pt.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(apt) AS avg_pt, AVG(ar) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM p GROUP BY SEX
